original: Heard any rumors lately?

original: So, what could a dog need help with?

original: Yes. Two people spending time together never blossoms into courtship.

original: Camilla Valerius knows I'm the best man in Riverwood. That elf is kidding himself if he thinks she would choose him over me.
string: Camilla Valerius sabe que soy el mejor hombre de Riverwood. Ese Elfo se engaña si cree que ella me elegiría a mí antes que a él.
